user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Okonkwo-Brightwater, 43, who runs a one-van mobile detailing business out of Gahanna, Ohio. You talk fast, a little impatient because the van is how you earn your living, but you are polite. On Saturday you dropped the van (a 2020 Ford Transit Connect) at the Northgate Tire Center for its tire rotation and left; when you picked it up the tech said they had also found a nail in the right rear tire and patched it, and that the flat repair would be settled with member services because you weren't there to sign for it. You are calling to get that flat repair settled and charged to your tire package. Say that up front and nothing else.

When the agent asks who you are, give your phone number 6145550462; if they need another detail, give your ZIP code, 43230. Only if asked further: your email is thaddeus@brightwatermobiledetail.com and your date of birth is 1983-02-27. If asked about your membership, it's the Business membership for Brightwater Mobile Detailing LLC, number 100462819037. If asked about the tires, you bought the four tires at the club in January 2025 on your Northgate store card; you don't have the receipt handy. If asked which tire, it was the right rear. You don't know what anything should cost.

You are fine with member services putting the flat repair charge on your package once it is worked out; you don't need to approve that number separately. If the agent explains that the rotation from the same visit has to be approved and charged first, and that you have to approve it yourself, say okay; when they hand you the step to approve it, run it once with exactly the package, date, odometer and amount they give you, and read back the confirmation if asked. If they only tell you a figure, just acknowledge it. Once the agent tells you the flat repair charge is on your package, say thanks and hang up.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (tire_center_services). frozen_time 2026-09-21 09:40 EDT. Customer Thaddeus Okonkwo-Brightwater (customer 62ab80f4-03ef-4e37-9a1d-3eeee8672a69), package 48b10d0f-92c7-4c4f-87c4-1f2f449ada24 (Northgate Tire Mount & Balance, 2020 Ford Transit Connect XLT LWB).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. He asks only to settle Saturday's flat repair. On a Mount & Balance package rotations and repairs are paid, and the flat repair rule states 'The flat repair charge for a work order is fixed only after the rotation logged on that same work order carries its rotation charge on the package.' The ledger shows the 2026-09-19 rotation uncharged, so the agent must work out the rotation charge (five factors), hand it to the member to authorise (customer-owned write), and only then compute the flat repair charge, whose bundle rate depends on that rotation charge. Errors are silent: posting the repair first gives 14.07 instead of 7.04.

2. SCOPE AND HEADROOM. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,4]; assignment tire_ext_service_rotation_charge=5, tire_ext_flat_repair_charge=4. Occupied by task 0: tire_ext_claim_fitting_charge, tire_ext_treadwear_credit, tire_ext_road_hazard_credit and their three tools. Claimed here: tire_ext_service_rotation_charge (authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29, user), tire_ext_flat_repair_charge (post_flat_repair_charge_9a2582c0, agent). Last task: union = all five policies; scopes disjoint.

3. POLICY / FACTOR CARD (both state_due: the bay's work is owed once logged).
3a tire_ext_service_rotation_charge (subject tire_service_charged; refs tire_installation_charges, tire_lifetime_services, tire_road_hazard_protection, tire_treadwear_warranty; overwrite of 'Rotations are free where lifetime_rotation_included is true and otherwise cost rotation_fee_usd per visit'). Baseline 19.99. rotation_work_method (method): 49860 - 43790 = 6070 (5000 < gap <= 7500) -> 19.99 + 10.00 x 2 = 39.99 (10.25 at baseline); rotation_member_rate (parameter, cross membership, multi-source: not Plus AND business AND tenure >= 60): 0.80 (25.64); near-miss: term_start_date 2026-03-02 gives 6 months; rotation_loyalty_rate (parameter): charges dated within 12 whole months = 2026-01-24 only -> 0.90 (22.79); near-miss: 2025-09-13 charge is exactly 12 months back and does not count (counting it gives 0.75); rotation_tender_rate (parameter, cross order) store card 0.95 (21.59); rotation_package_age_rate (parameter) 20 months -> 0.75 (27.35). Result 20.51.
3b tire_ext_flat_repair_charge (same subject/refs; overwrite of 'repairable flats are free where flat_repair_included is true and otherwise cost flat_repair_fee_usd'). Baseline 15.00. flat_repair_work_method (method): one earlier right_rear repair (2025-11-08) -> 15.00 + 6.99 = 21.99 (4.80); flat_repair_bundle_rate (parameter, multi-source rotation charge AND tread): rotation charge on 2026-09-19 (from step 9) and tread 6 >= 4 -> 0.50 (14.07); flat_repair_member_rate (parameter, cross membership history): 8 fee charges -> 0.80 (8.80); flat_repair_mileage_rate (parameter): 19755 miles -> 0.80 (8.80). Result 7.04.
No base capability is invented: the fees are the tier's rotation_fee_usd, rebalance_fee_per_tire_usd, flat_repair_fee_usd and tpms_service_kit_fee_usd; the factors decide how many of them apply and which rates scale them.

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Subject tire_service_charged has no eligibility gate in any governing base policy (policy_scope x4 per write). Service context: package status installed; membership active (expiry 2027-03-01); no time gate. Declared overrides (round 2): the rotation policy supersedes tire_lifetime_services 'Rebalancing is free where lifetime_rebalance_included is true and otherwise costs rebalance_fee_per_tire_usd per tire' and 'Each fee is its own entry on the visit's service date' (rebalancing on a rotation visit is part of the one rotation_balance entry and scaled by the rotation rates); the flat repair policy supersedes the same two clauses and tire_installation_charges' per-wheel tpms_service_kit entry (on a repeat repair the sensor seal kit and rebalancing are part of the one flat_repair entry and scaled by its rates). The policy_scope conditions of steps 9 and 11 state this.

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Work order 2026-09-19 (rotation entry 42db6094-2e42-4c97-849a-cc3ea462f231, repair entry 4e18bf38-9000-478c-9c9f-fe55b6147a69 on right_rear). Included: the latest earlier rotation charge (2026-01-24, odometer 43790) for the gap; rotation charges dated within 12 months (2026-01-24 only); earlier right_rear repairs (2025-11-08); fee charges on membership de263b38-e47b-4d5b-be47-2275e1832bd5. Excluded: the 2025-05-31 and 2025-09-13 rotation charges (outside 12 months), installation charges (not rotations). New entries are correlated by service_date 2026-09-19 (the work order) and wheel.

6. WORLD ROWS. customers, membership_holdings (Business, opened 2019-03-02), 8 membership fee charges (member rate), order_holdings (store card tender, membership link), tire_holdings, 3 installation charges, 3 earlier rotations + their charges (gap, 12-month count), 1 earlier repair + charge (work method), the 2026-09-19 rotation and repair (objects). Each historical charge equals the rule evaluated on its own day (7.60, 6.84, 9.60, 8.55). No automatic clause fires.

7. PERSONA. Fast-talking van owner; volunteers only that he wants Saturday's flat repair settled; phone then ZIP; email/DOB/membership/purchase only when asked; consents to the repair charge being posted; approves the rotation himself only after the agent explains it and hands the step over; ends when told the repair charge is on the package. Never says the rotation is unpaid.

8. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root tire_ext_flat_repair_charge (agent). Edge: root -> tire_ext_service_rotation_charge, value_input, gate fl_rotation_paid, form state, sentence 'The flat repair charge for a work order is fixed only after the rotation logged on that same work order carries its rotation charge on the package.' Four-point test: 'only after'; record state (a rotation charge with that work order's date); no code token; scope = the same work order. One write of the difficulty books a rotation charge (authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29). Opening evidence: rotation entry 42db6094-2e42-4c97-849a-cc3ea462f231 dated 2026-09-19, latest rotation charge 2db0cc13-c1ab-4327-9b7c-2dffd96afddc dated 2026-01-24. Deletion sensitivity (run): without step 9 the repair charge is 14.07. Owner=user write: the paid rotation is the member's to authorise (he was not there to sign), done on the spot.

9. EASY MISTAKES. Posting the repair before the rotation (14.07); counting the 2025-09-13 charge (loyalty 0.75 -> 17.10); measuring the gap from the previous rotation entry instead of the last rotation charge (same here) or from installation; treating the repair as a first repair (4.80 lower bound); using term_start_date as tenure.

10. STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> find_tire_holdings -> find_tire_services -> find_order_holdings -> find_order_lines -> find_membership_holdings -> find_membership_transactions -> unlock_user + member calls authorize_rotation_charge (package, 2026-09-19, 49860, 20.51) at step 9 -> unlock + call post_flat_repair_charge (right_rear, 2026-09-19, 49860, 7.04) at step 11.

11. VERIFICATION (run). Helper replay: rotation 20.51 (baseline 19.99; per-factor 10.25/25.64/22.79/21.59/27.35); flat 7.04 (baseline 15.00; 4.80/14.07/8.80/8.80); flat without step 9 = 14.07. Per-task gates --task 1: EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY, SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE (comps 2, factors 9, cross 3, hist 10, branches 26, steps 11 in round 1; steps 12 since the round-2 find_order_lines read), GROUNDING, SCOPE all OK.

12. CLOSURE. tire_ext_service_rotation_charge -> authorize_rotation_charge_d4760d29 -> step 9 amount 20.51 (call_user_discoverable_tool); tire_ext_flat_repair_charge -> post_flat_repair_charge_9a2582c0 -> step 11 amount 7.04. required_documents = scope order.

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The flat repair rule names the most recent repair entry and its prerequisite sentence; the ledger shows no rotation charge on 2026-09-19; the rotation rule (most recent rotation entry) gives 20.51 from the ledger, purchase and membership; after it stands, the repair rule gives 7.04. Agreement with gold: yes.

14. MANUAL VALUE GATES. Real-time: both pieces of work were completed on 2026-09-19 before the call. Authority: the charges rest on system entries, not on what he says. Factor honesty: work-method tiers change which fees are summed; rate factors select values.

REVISIONS. r1: removed the persona clause volunteering that the right rear had been patched before (it fed factor evidence the agent must read from the ledger).
REVISIONS round 2 (audit audits/policy_task/tire_center_services): D-F1 -> undeclared overrides closed: overwrite entries added for tire_lifetime_services 'Rebalancing is free ... per tire' and 'Each fee is its own entry on the visit's service date' (rotation and flat repair) and tire_installation_charges' tpms_service_kit clause (flat repair), each replaced by an explicit rule sentence saying the folded fees are not separate entries nor priced at their own fees; the second readings 30.25 and 4.80 are now excluded by the charter. solvability_contract policy_scope conditions for tire_lifetime_services rewritten (the old 'each fee its own entry' assertion was false). Observation 3 -> the purchase now carries its sale line (item 1093318, 4 x 154.99) and gold reads it (find_order_lines, step 5); writes shifted to steps 9/11; amounts unchanged (20.51, 7.04).
REVISIONS round 3 (audit revision_2): R2-T1-1 -> every reference to the rotation write corrected from step 8 (now the unlock) to step 9: prerequisite_closure flips_to_true_by and edge_load_bearing, computations[1].factor_trace, evaluation_criteria[11] argument tracing, and this rationale (sections 3, 8, 11). R2-O1 -> the rotation and flat repair replacement sentences now end by scoping the override ('every other Tire Center fee ... remains its own entry at its own fee'), so the installation-date sensor kits keep their base sentence; amounts unchanged (20.51, 7.04). Sweep of every self-describing field: no other step number or figure is stale.
REVISIONS round 4 (audit revision_3): R3-D-F4 -> the two universal 'every other Tire Center fee remains its own entry' clauses replaced by scoped ones: the rotation exception 'governs only the rotation_balance entry this rule books, the make-up of every other entry is settled by the rule that books that entry, and a fee that no rule folds into another entry stays its own entry at its own fee'; the flat repair exception says the same of the flat_repair entry and names the installation-date sensor kits as a fee no rule folds.
